subject: SLO uplift & committed capacity — addendum for Oct renewal
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@streamlineanalytics.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@streamlineanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal request — SLO uplift + capacity bump

Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Streamline's current contract (ends 2027-10-31) is up for renewal and leadership has asked us to formalize the following changes before signing the renewal: 1) upgrade to Redwood Premium SLA with a documented latency SLO (95th percentile p95 under 150ms for text generation in us-west region), 2) committed dedicated capacity increase of ~2x peak (we expect monthly peak tokens to rise ~110% in Q1 2028), and 3) extended 24/7 priority support (phone on-call for incident severity 1).

I've attached a short request doc with our traffic forecasts and the renewal timeline (Streamline_Renewal_Request_Sept2027.pdf). Can you confirm whether these items can be added as an amendment (DocuSign) to our current agreement, what the delta in recurring cost would be, and any lead time required for provisioning the extra Dedicated nodes? Also, we'll need a short rollout plan for a canary phase (two-week ramp) so our SREs can coordinate.

Best,
Elena
Director of ML Ops
Streamline Analytics

(Attachment: Streamline_Renewal_Request_Sept2027.pdf)

Proposed immediate next steps: 1) Marissa to propose the SLA matrix and pricing delta, 2) Neha to confirm support hours and on-call ops flow, 3) schedule a technical kickoff for a canary rollout (30–45 minute deep dive). Are you available Thu 9/23 at 11:00 PT or Fri 9/24 at 14:00 PT?

I'll flag the renewal in our deal tracker and prepare a draft addendum for review.

—Jonas

jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@streamlineanalytics.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request — SLO uplift + capacity bump

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually). Attached is a proposed SLA matrix and a pricing addendum outlining the uplift for Premium SLA plus the committed Dedicated capacity increase (sla_matrix_2027.xlsx, pricing_addendum_v2.pdf). High level: 

- Premium SLA (99.95% availability, priority 24/7 support, designated on-call) + latency SLO: p95 < 150ms for text-generation on us-west region. We will include observability hooks (token-level latency charts) and quarterly SLO reviews.
- Committed capacity: we can reserve the requested 2x peak capacity as a Dedicated pool. Lead time for provisioning is typically 10 business days from signed amendment, and we'll provision a temporary burst pool during the canary if needed.
- Pricing: estimated recurring uplift is ~18% on current committed spend for the SLA; Dedicated capacity increase is priced as a separate line (expected $14,000/mo for the added pool; see the addendum for exact numbers and term options).

Next steps I propose: 1) technical kickoff Thu 2027-09-23 11:00 PT (join link below), 2) Marissa draft addendum (will send by EOD after call), 3) confirm billing account and sign via DocuSign.

Proposed kickoff link: https://meet.redwood.com/549-uptier-kickoff

Thanks,
Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: sla_matrix_2027.xlsx, pricing_addendum_v2.pdf)

From: Elena Park <elena@streamlineanalytics.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@streamlineanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request — SLO uplift + capacity bump

Marissa / Jonas — thanks for the fast turnaround. Thu 11:00 PT works for our team. A few clarifications before the call: 

1) For the p95 < 150ms SLO — will that be scoped to a single API route (text-generation, default params) or across all model variants? We prefer a route-scoped SLO for predictable billing.
2) Our EU traffic will grow soon — can we include a fallback region policy in the addendum (if us-west capacity is constrained, route to eu-west with a documented latency delta)?
3) We will need a one-time migration credit to offset validation/testing costs (requesting a $7,500 credit).

I'll have procurement on the kickoff call and they'll want to see the DocuSign addendum and an estimated invoice schedule after sign.

Thanks,
Elena

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@streamlineanalytics.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, finance@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request — SLO uplift + capacity bump

Thanks all — good kickoff. Quick notes and commitments from Redwood: 

- SLO scoping: we'll define the latency SLO on the "text-generation.default" route (explicit in the addendum) and list model variants that are covered. EU fallback policy: included as an appendix with prescribed latency delta and failover order.
- Provisioning: 10 business days post-sign for full Dedicated pool; we will stand up a temporary burst pool during canary (no extra charge for the two-week canary).
- Credit: we can approve a one-time $5,000 migration/validation credit. Marissa and I discussed this with finance — it's within our renewal concession band.

I'll attach the draft addendum after the call (redwood_addendum_draft.docx) and route via DocuSign with the HubSpot deal linked (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4729). Please confirm the billing contact and the email to send DocuSign to.

—Jonas

(Attachment: redwood_addendum_draft.docx)
